features.text: Parameterized counter with an asynchronous active-low reset
Increment enable with wrap from the maximum value to zero

requirements.title: While i_rst_n is low, q shall be 4'b0000.
requirements.text: While i_rst_n is low, q shall be 4'b0000.
requirements.evidence: While `i_rst_n` is low, `q` shall be `4'b0000`. Reset assertion is asynchronous;

requirements.title: q shall change only on the rising edge of i_clk.
requirements.text: q shall change only on the rising edge of i_clk.
requirements.evidence: `q` shall change only on the rising edge of `i_clk`.

requirements.title: When i_inc is 1 and q is not 15, q shall increment by 1 on the next rising edge
requirements.text: When i_inc is 1 and q is not 15, q shall increment by 1 on the next rising edge of i_clk.
requirements.evidence: When `i_inc` is 1 and `q` is not 15, `q` shall increment by 1 on the next rising edge of `i_clk`.

requirements.title: When i_inc is 0, q shall hold its value on the next rising edge of i_clk.
requirements.text: When i_inc is 0, q shall hold its value on the next rising edge of i_clk.
requirements.evidence: When `i_inc` is 0, `q` shall hold its value on the next rising edge of `i_clk`.

requirements.title: When i_inc is 1 and q is 15, q shall wrap to 0 on the next rising edge of i_clk.
requirements.text: When i_inc is 1 and q is 15, q shall wrap to 0 on the next rising edge of i_clk.
requirements.evidence: When `i_inc` is 1 and `q` is 15, `q` shall wrap to 0 on the next rising edge of `i_clk`.

requirements.title: A cycle with i_inc 1 and q 0 shall be reachable after reset.
requirements.text: A cycle with i_inc 1 and q 0 shall be reachable after reset.
requirements.evidence: A cycle with `i_inc` 1 and `q` 0 shall be reachable after reset.

requirements.title: The counter output q shall be WIDTH bits wide.
requirements.text: The counter output q shall be WIDTH bits wide.
requirements.evidence: The counter output `q` shall be `WIDTH` bits wide.
